meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把口播或访谈视频加上随字幕同步的图形卡片,原片画面保持不动
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有口播或访谈素材,想加同步图形卡但不想动原画面。
copy.tagline_en: Add transcript-synced graphic cards to your talking-head video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have talking-head footage and want graphic cards fast

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会给已有的口播、访谈或播客视频叠加按时间对齐的图文卡片——标题、下三分之一、数据标注、引用、侧栏、画中画,原片原样播放;画布可选 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5,最终渲染成 MP4。
howto.when: 当你提到“graphic overlays”、“on-screen graphics”等词,或要求包装、美化视频时接管。不用于纯字幕(那是 /embedded-captions);意图不明先看 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这条口播视频叠上图文字卡,用 9:16 竖版画布。
say.note: 先读转写稿,再逐张设计卡片并渲染 MP4

say.text: 给这段访谈加下三分之一和数据标注卡片,原片保持不动。
say.note: 卡片时长会跟转写时间戳对齐

say.text: 这段播客加引用卡和画中画,按 16:9 输出。

howto.what_en: Claude adds timed, designed graphic cards — titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, PiP — onto an existing talking-head or podcast clip, synced to the transcript; clip plays untouched. Canvas: 16:9/9:16/4:5; renders MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics" or packaging/dressing up your video. Not for plain subtitles (use /embedded-captions); if unclear, read /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Overlay graphic cards on this talking-head clip, 9:16 vertical canvas.
say_en.note: Reads the transcript, designs cards, renders MP4.

say_en.text: Add lower-third and data-callout cards to this interview, clip untouched.
say_en.note: Card timings follow the transcript timestamps.

say_en.text: Add quote cards and picture-in-picture to this podcast, output 16:9.
